name: ModelVariant175_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant175_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (two waves of rings leave one of this slot's parts, swing sideways and fly to the other slot, warping the screen behind them while they spin and throwing a fading burst of lines when they arrive); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, builds the three 17-point ring outlines and clears the ring positions, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 until the first wave is four fifths through, 4 until the second wave has arrived, 1 once and then 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-192 and 322 images build it from the same source with the US layout. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
